checkpoints.title: Requirements rationale and satisfy links
checkpoints.description: Reusable syntactic gate: every requirement carries its rationale and every satisfy link resolves to a declared requirement. Reuses the shipped simple_requirements.py checker.

rules.condition: XDesignRequirements declares at least one requirement, and every requirement declaration inside it carries a nonempty rationale attribute.
The declared traceability source has at least one satisfy link, and every satisfy link names a requirement declared inside XDesignRequirements.

checkpoints.title: Verification evidence answers every requirement
checkpoints.description: Reusable semantic gate: a permitted judge must be able to re-examine the retained evidence and see every requirement answered, without re-asking the author.
criteria: Every requirement has retained evidence that a reader can re-examine.
The evidence and the record stand on their own without re-asking the author.
